name: Junior H
bio: Antonio Herrera Pérez, known professionally as Junior H, is a pioneering Mexican singer-songwriter at the forefront of the Corridos Tumbados and Sad Sierreño movement.

name: Peso Pluma
bio: Hassan Emilio Kabande Laija, known as Peso Pluma, is an international superstar credited with bringing Corridos Tumbados to the top of global charts.

name: Natanael Cano
bio: Natanael Cano is recognized as the creator and father of the Corridos Tumbados movement.

name: Fuerza Regida
bio: Fuerza Regida is a powerhouse Mexican-American band from San Bernardino, California, led by front-man Jesús Ortiz Paz (JOP), dominating global streaming charts.

name: Oscar Maydon
bio: Oscar Maydon is a hitmaking Mexican singer-songwriter behind massive viral hits like Fin de Semana and Madonna.

name: Gabito Ballesteros
bio: Gabriel Ballesteros Abril, known as Gabito Ballesteros, is a singer and instrumentalist from Cumpas, Sonora, known for his signature clarinet arrangements and chart-topping corridos.

name: Tito Double P
bio: Jesús Roberto Laija García, known as Tito Double P, is a hit songwriter and recording artist responsible for shaping modern Mexican corridos anthems.

name: Xavi
bio: Joshua Xavier Gutierrez, known as Xavi, is a breakout sensation born in Phoenix, Arizona, famed for his soulful romantic corridos that conquered worldwide viral charts.

name: Eslabon Armado
bio: Eslabon Armado is an American regional Mexican band from Patterson, California, led by Pedro Tovar, famous for the historic global smash hit Ella Baila Sola.

name: Grupo Frontera
bio: Grupo Frontera is an American band formed in Edinburg, Texas, renowned for revitalizing modern norteño-cumbia with chart-topping romantic anthems.

name: Edén Muñoz
bio: Rodolfo Edén Muñoz Cantú is an acclaimed Mexican singer-songwriter, producer, and accordionist from Los Mochis, Sinaloa, formerly the leader and primary composer of Calibre 50.

name: Netón Vega
bio: Ernesto Vega, known as Netón Vega, is a breakout corrido artist from La Paz, Baja California Sur, behind major chart-topping anthems like Si No Quieres No.

name: DannyLux
bio: Daniel Balderrama Espinoza, known as DannyLux, blends vintage 60s/70s Latin acoustic vibes with melancholic sierreño.

name: Ivan Cornejo
bio: Ivan Cornejo is a Riverside, California singer-songwriter whose emotive guitar melodies and heart-wrenching lyrics defined modern Sad Sierreño.

name: Marca MP
bio: Marca MP is a California-based regional Mexican group led by Pedro 'Chato' Vargas, renowned for their emotive requinto and melodic vocals.

name: Chino Pacas
bio: Cristian Humberto Ávila Vega, known as Chino Pacas, is a breakout star from Apaseo el Alto, Guanajuato, celebrated for his high-energy street corridos.

name: Luis R Conriquez
bio: Luis Roberto Conriquez is a powerhouse singer from Caborca, Sonora, recognized as the pioneer of Corridos Bélicos.

name: Jasiel Nuñez
bio: Jasiel Nuñez is a Mexican singer-songwriter from Guadalajara, signed to Double P Records, famed for Rosa Pastel, Lagunas, and Bipolar.

name: Herencia de Patrones
bio: Herencia de Patrones is a pioneer of the Corridos Verdes movement from Yuba City, California, blending heavy basslines with West Coast street themes.

name: Ovi
bio: Ovidio Crespo Retureta, known as Ovi, is a Cuban-born singer and rapper based in the US, influential in fusing Latin Trap with Corridos Tumbados alongside Rancho Humilde.

name: El Komander
bio: José Alfredo Ríos Meza, 'El Komander', is a legendary Mexican singer-songwriter from Culiacán, Sinaloa, who spearheaded the Movimiento Alterado movement.

name: Grupo Marca Registrada
bio: Grupo Marca Registrada is a high-charting Mexican group from Culiacán, Sinaloa, led by Fidel Castro, known for hits like El Rescate, Di Que Sí, and Si Fuera Fácil.

name: Ariel Camacho y Los Plebes del Rancho
bio: Ariel Camacho y Los Plebes del Rancho defined the acoustic sierreño era with pristine dual-guitar arrangements and iconic heartfelt corridos.

name: Los Tucanes de Tijuana
bio: Los Tucanes de Tijuana, led by Mario Quintero Lara, are renowned for iconic energetic party cumbias and legendary narrations of Mexican folklore.

name: Banda MS
bio: Banda Sinaloense MS de Sergio Lizárraga, widely known as Banda MS, is a legendary 16-member banda formed in Mazatlán, Sinaloa.

name: Banda El Recodo
genre: Banda Sinaloense / La Madre de Todas las Bandas
bio: Banda El Recodo de Cruz Lizárraga, founded in 1938, is revered as 'La Madre de Todas las Bandas' and the most legendary brass orchestra in Mexican music history.

name: La Arrolladora Banda El Limón
bio: La Arrolladora Banda El Limón de René Camacho is one of the most commercially successful and influential banda groups in Mexican music.

name: Grupo Firme
bio: Grupo Firme, founded by Eduin Caz in Tijuana, Baja California, revolutionized modern live Mexican music and stadium tours across the globe.

name: La Adictiva
bio: La Adictiva (formerly La Adictiva Banda San José de Mesillas) is a renowned Sinaloan brass band famous for modern romantic hits and major collaborations like JGL.

name: Calibre 50
bio: Calibre 50 is a powerhouse norteño group from Mazatlán, Sinaloa, holding the record for the most number-one songs on the Billboard Regional Mexican Airplay chart.

name: Los Tigres del Norte
bio: Known as 'Los Jefes de Jefes', Los Tigres del Norte are the ultimate legends of Mexican norteño music with over 50 years of storytelling and multiple Grammys.

name: Los Dos Carnales
genre: Norteño Tradicional / Corridos de la Vieja Escuela
bio: Los Dos Carnales are brothers Poncho and Imanol Quezada from San Pedro de las Colonias, Coahuila, credited with reviving vintage 1970s acoustic norteño roots.

name: Codiciado
bio: Erick Aragón, former frontman of Grupo Codiciado, is a pioneering songwriter known for modern Tijuana street corridos like Gente de Accionar and Bélico El Asunto.

name: Panter Bélico
bio: Melitón Arredondo, known as Panter Bélico, is the charismatic former lead singer of Grupo Arriesgado, celebrated for his gravelly vocals and energetic stage presence.

name: Tony Aguirre
bio: Tony Aguirre is an accomplished Mexican singer-songwriter from Ciudad Obregón, Sonora, collaborating frequently with Peso Pluma, Luis R Conriquez, and Natanael Cano.

name: Victor Cibrian
bio: Victor Cibrian is a talented instrumentalist and singer from Puerto Peñasco, Sonora, famous for the worldwide viral hit En El Radio Un Cochinero.

name: Yahritza y Su Esencia
bio: Yahritza Y Su Esencia is a sibling trio from Yakima, Washington, known for Yahritza Martinez's powerful vocal texture and emotive acoustic sierreño arrangements.

name: Pepe Aguilar
bio: José Antonio Aguilar Jiménez, 'Pepe Aguilar', is a four-time Grammy and five-time Latin Grammy winner, carrying forward the legendary Aguilar family mariachi dynasty.

name: Belinda
genre: Pop Latino / Corridos Coquette / Electro Pop
bio: Belinda Peregrín Schüll, 'La Princesa del Pop Latino', is an iconic Mexican singer and actress with multi-platinum albums and groundbreaking 2024 Corridos Coquette releases like Cactus and 300 Noches.

name: Ángela Aguilar
bio: Ángela Aguilar Álvarez is an acclaimed Mexican-American singer, daughter of Pepe Aguilar and granddaughter of Antonio Aguilar and Flor Silvestre, renowned for preserving authentic Mexican mariachi traditions.

name: Luis Miguel
genre: Bolero / Pop Latino / Mariachi / El Sol de México
bio: Luis Miguel Gallego Basteri, 'El Sol de México', is universally regarded as the greatest Latin pop vocalist of all time, selling over 100 million records worldwide.

name: Kenia OS
bio: Kenia Guadalupe Flores Osuna, known as Kenia OS, is a Mexican pop superstar from Mazatlán, Sinaloa, who has broken streaming records with hits like Malas Decisiones and Kitty.

name: Santa Fe Klan
bio: Ángel Jair Quezada Jasso, known as Santa Fe Klan, is a Mexican rapper and accordionist from Guanajuato who fused urban street rap with authentic cumbia sonidera.

name: Alejandro Fernández
bio: Alejandro Fernández Abarca, 'El Potrillo', son of Vicente Fernández, is a global superstar with over 30 million records sold across ranchera and pop ballads.
